action_legality_checks.policy_evidence: Policy allows modifying items in a pending order after explicit user confirmation, provided all details are summarized and the user confirms the exact changes and payment method. Only one modify_pending_order_items call is allowed per order.
action_legality_checks.conversation_evidence: Assistant summarized both item changes, price differences, payment method, and post-modification consequences. User explicitly confirmed all details and requested to proceed.
action_legality_checks.reasoning: The assistant verified order status, item availability, price differences, and payment method sufficiency. All requested changes were summarized and confirmed by the user before the write. The action was performed in a single call as required by policy.
